title: HOUR, MINUTE and SECOND of a dateTime with a time part
query: EVALUATE VAR t = dt"2020-10-15T22:45:30" RETURN ROW ( "h", HOUR ( t ), "m", MINUTE ( t ), "s", SECOND ( t ) )

source.quote: Returns the hour as a number from 0 (12:00 A.M.) to 23 (11:00 P.M.).
source.supports: HOUR on a 24-hour clock; an integer

source.quote: Returns the minute as a number from 0 to 59, given a date and time value.
